description:
Return one blocked task's existing pull request to normal review.

    Requires a personal OAuth connection of an active workspace owner;
    workspace keys are refused. Pass the task id (not an escalation id), the
    PR's exact 40-character head SHA, a reason (1-2000 characters) and a
    request_id you choose (1-128 of letters, digits, `.`, `:`, `_`, `-`). The
    task's own open keelen/iter-* PR must be green and cleanly mergeable at
    that head, and its latest DEV run must have verified that head. Status
    becomes done (implementation awaiting review), never delivered. Review,
    CI, acceptance and merge gates still apply; no retry starts and no budget
    resets. The same request_id and arguments replay the stored receipt. A
    refusal returns ok=false, reason review_requeue_refused, a stable
    cause_code and a fixed message.
name: requeue_for_review
title: Requeue Task for Review
